verdict.rationale: Vast Serverless is explicitly documented as pay-per-execution (not GPU rental time) with autoscaling that recruits the best price-performance GPU for the workload, and it's driven via a Python SDK/CLI — directly matching the story of deploying to autoscaling GPU workers instead of always-on instances. Missing for 10: explicit 'scale to zero' terminology/behavior documentation and independent/hands-on corroboration of the serverless autoscaling in practice.
